mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts by more than 5% in two months signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% in two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% in a month indicates supply chain disruptions or reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month, coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% in the same month, signals strong consumer demand and labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% in a quarter indicates a contraction in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% in a quarter.
